summary: Law of One guide on what each density from fourth to eighth adds; a verifier checks quotes verbatim; a fresh reader checks labels

claims.claim: Ra calls third density the density of self-consciousness (self-awareness), where mind/body complexes become mind/body/spirit complexes. Paraphrase, checked against the raw lawofone.info text.

Asked why third density is so short next to first and second, Ra answers that third density is a choice. Ra then calls it precisely correct that third density exists for the purpose of that choice, and says the choice is brief (the work of a moment) yet the axis on which creation turns. Ra adds that a prelude (laying the foundation, the illusion, what can be made spiritually viable) comes first.
Ra says choosing a polarity is necessary to be harvestable from third density, and that the higher densities do their work on the strength of the polarity gained in this choice.
Ra says polarity begins to be explored only when a third-density entity becomes aware that it can choose between service to self and service to others, which ends the innocent, unselfconscious phase.

Ra rejects the idea that the choice was designed to make intensity past third density. Fourth density refines a rough sculpture. Third density is where the form is forged by fire, an intensity Ra says fourth, fifth, sixth and seventh do not have. Ra also says the veils that make the choice possible belong to third density (77.14).

Ra says fourth density lifts the veil and that the choice has already been made there. This is said in passing, in an answer about sexual energy transfer in higher densities. The only verbatim quote in this output.
claims.quote: [removed from the public copy; verbatim at lawofone.info, session 87.25]

claims.claim: Ra says there is little work in consciousness in fourth and fifth density compared with third. Positive fourth-density work is the social memory complex serving less polarized others. Negative fourth-density work is the struggle for position, then reaching out to less polarized others.

Explaining why polarizing needs incarnation with forgetting, Ra says that in the green density in time/space everyone's thoughts and feelings are open to view and deception is neither possible nor wanted. Much harmony can be done there, but little polarity is gained.

Nuance: the choice is not frozen at the end of third density. In the case Ra discusses (a positive entity incarnated into a thoroughly negative environment), reversing polarity may be delayed until mid-sixth density.

The common label is third density is the density of choice. Ra's own wording in the cited places is that third density is a choice, with polarization needed for harvest. The label is a fair summary but not Ra's phrase.

Answer to third versus fourth: by Ra's text the choice is made in third density, with its deadline at harvest. Fourth density is where the chosen polarity is lived and intensified (social memory complexes, service or control), and the higher densities refine it. I found no Ra statement that fourth density adds the choice.
Ra names fourth density the density of love, also called understanding. Ra warns this is not the same sense as the second distortion, Love (see q8).

Ra first says fourth density cannot be described positively in words and gives what it is not plus approximations: one is aware of other-selves' thoughts and vibrations, it has compassion and understanding for third density's sorrows, it strives toward wisdom or light, and individual differences are marked but harmonized by group consensus.

Ra calls fourth density one of revealed information: selves are not hidden from self or others, so imbalances show plainly in the body and work as a teaching resource. See also 38.14 and 66.30: telepathy and transparency of thought also apply to negative fourth density, where it is hard to hide true vibrations.

Ra says fourth density abounds in compassion, which seen through wisdom is folly. It is the salvation of third density but leaves the entity unbalanced, and Ra's own social memory complex leaned toward martyrdom in fourth density.

Ra defines a social memory complex as a social complex whose whole group shares one orientation or seeking. The group memory lost to individuals in the roots of mind becomes known to the social complex, with less distortion in self-understanding and in pursuing its direction. Ra later says fourth and sixth density find these quite necessary (45.11).

Ra says each density's base frequency is its true color and that the term cannot be fully defined in our measures (40.6). Fourth density's true color is green, and Ra says the environment's vibratory nature at the time was green, heavily overlaid by the orange ray of planetary consciousness.
At the time of contact Ra says the planet is third density in the beingness of its entities but already in a fourth-density space/time, which makes the harvest difficult.
Ra says many will repeat the third-density cycle, because entry into the vibration of love is not effective with the present scattered societal complex.

Ra estimates the planetary transition at roughly 100 to 700 years and says this cannot be accurate because of how volatile people are. Ra calls about 2011 an approximate, probable/possible nexus for harvest (17.29). These are estimates, not fixed dates.

Ra describes the planet electromagnetically realigning for fourth density with some disruption, a new breed incarnating for fourth-density work, and a short-run rise in negative orientation. Those who remain in fourth density on this plane will be positively oriented. A fourth-density sphere coexists with the earlier densities (63.8).
Ra calls fifth density the density of light or wisdom.
Ra says that on reaching fifth density its own social memory complex saw the flaws in unrelieved fourth-density compassion, and spent a long time contemplating how to imbue love with wisdom.
Ra says fifth-density harvest is of those who consciously accept the honor/duty of the Law of One. Conscious awareness of the Law of One is not needed for third to fourth (16.40).
Asked what fifth and sixth density rays look like, Ra says only approximately that fifth density is best described as extremely white in vibration. This describes appearance, not a named true color.

Ra calls the wisdom density an extremely free density. Entities may learn as a social memory complex or as individual mind/body/spirit complexes and graduate to sixth either way. In fourth density the whole social memory complex must be harvestable.

Ra says fifth density's action, viewed in space/time, is the same with or without polarity, but the experience of wisdom in time/space is enlarged and deepened by voluntary polarized action. Fifth-density negative has ceased activity except by thought and is extraordinarily compacted and separate (25.11).

Difference from fourth, per Ra's passages: fourth is love and compassion, transparent selves, and group service to less polarized others, and the whole social memory complex is harvested. Fifth is wisdom that tests that compassion, it can be pursued individually or in a group, and it is still polarized. Positive fifth learns from sixth-density teachers and sends light out, and negative fifth compacts into the self. This is my synthesis of the cited passages, not one Ra sentence.

Ra calls sixth density the density of unity. There the positive and negative paths must take in each other, since all must be seen as love/light and light/love. This is easy for the positive and hard enough for the negative that at some point the negative polarity is abandoned. Ra frames this as the negative path giving up its polarity, not as an even blend of two poles.
Ra says the work of sixth density is to unify wisdom and compassion. Sixth density is where the balance of compassion and wisdom is perfected (52.9).
Ra describes the color progression as fifth blending the compassion learned in fourth into wisdom, then sixth blending wisdom back into a unified understanding of compassion seen with wisdom.
Ra describes sixth density's appearance as a whiteness with a golden quality. The gold is not in our spectrum and is what Ra calls alive. Again an appearance description, not a named true color.

Ra says positive/negative polarity becomes history at the sixth level. Ra says of its own work that it now seeks without polarity, and that the balances sought are those between compassion and wisdom (64.6).

Ra says it is sixth density, strongly seeking seventh, with its own harvest about 2.5 million years away. Ra's route (41.26): Venus, harmonious graduations, a long stay in fifth density balancing fourth-density compassion.

Ra says the higher self is given to the late sixth-density entity as a gift from its future self, by the mid-seventh-density self as its last act before turning to the allness of the Creator. Self, higher self (Oversoul) and mind/body/spirit complex totality are three points on one circle, distinct only in time/space. Ra says the totality and the higher self are not identical (36.10).
Ra calls seventh density a density of completion and of turning toward timelessness or foreverness. Ra says fourth, fifth and sixth density refine the higher energy centers.

Ra, in session 3, describes the laws sought in order: love, then light, then the Law of One, then the Law of Foreverness. It says it cannot say what lies past the dissolution of the unified self into all that is. Session 3 does not name densities, so lining this up with densities four to seven is an inference.
Ra expects, if its efforts suffice, to become one with all at the seventh level, with no memory, identity, past or future, existing in the all.

Ra calls seventh the gateway density. Spiritual mass grows slowly through the densities and then sharply there, where the summing up and looking back happens and polarity's useful functions are spent. The completed being, the Creator who knows Itself, gathers mass and compacts into the One Creator again.

Seventh-density color: Ra gives no true color for seventh density (a full-text search of all 106 sessions found none). Violet is described only as an energy center: constant, the mark or identity of the entity (39.10), and the Buddha or complete body (47.8). Calling seventh violet is the common order-based reading, not a Ra statement.
Ra says eighth density also functions as the first density, in its later stages, of the next octave.
Ra explains density by a music analogy: after seven notes the eighth begins a new octave. Within the great octave are seven densities, each with seven sub-densities, and so on.

Ra calls the octave both omega and alpha. The spiritual mass of the infinite universes becomes one central sun or Creator again, then a new universe and Logos is born that incorporates all the Creator has experienced. Ra says it knows very little across the octave boundary, and that the transition is timeless (40.1).
Ra says intelligent infinity is brought into intelligent energy from eighth density, the octave. The same session ties the eighth level to the opening of seventh through sixth (11.8).

Ra lists the densities as cycles of its own path: first awareness, second growth, third self-awareness, fourth love or understanding, fifth light or wisdom, sixth light/love, love/light or unity, seventh the gateway cycle, eighth the octave moving into a mystery Ra does not plumb.
Ra says each density is primarily its own ray plus the pull of the following ray, which draws it forward and tints it. The pull is toward the next density, not an inclusion of the previous ones.
Ra says each true-color density has all seven energy centers and each entity holds this in potentiation. Ra also says each entity contains all densities and sub-densities of the octave (71.13).
Ra says third density gives the potential for minimal activation of all energy centers and fourth to sixth refine the higher ones.
What is learned in sequence: compassion in fourth, blended into wisdom in fifth, then wisdom blended back into a unified understanding of compassion in sixth.
Ra says the density of love is where those who can love with little distortion go on to seek the ways of light or wisdom. Fifth grows out of fourth. Progress through densities is sequential (7.16).
Ra says the densities after third are continuous refining of the choice.

I found no Ra statement of a general rule that each density adds its lesson to, or contains, the previous ones. The nearest are 40.3 (forward pull), 48.10 and 71.13 (all densities held in potentiation) and 33.20 (learning handed on). Saying fifth includes fourth plus wisdom is my reading, and it fits Ra's compassion-to-wisdom passages.
Ra gives the order free will, then its focus as the second distortion (Logos, the creative principle, Love), then Light. Many hierarchies of distortions follow, none more important than another.

Ra separates the second distortion Love (the great activator and primal co-Creator) from the vibration or density of love. The density is where those who have learned to love with little distortion then seek light or wisdom. Do not conflate the two.

Ra does not map free will, Love and Light onto densities one, two and three. In Ra's text they are creation-level distortions (light is the first visible manifestation, 78.9), and densities one to three are red, orange and yellow (40.3). Any mapping between them is an overlay we would be adding.

Ra says first density's ray, red, is the foundation of all that follows, and second density's ray, orange, is movement and growth of the individual, striving toward yellow. Third is the equivalent, and so forth.
Ra gives yellow as the appropriate true color for third density, with green's influence now acting on yellow-ray entities.

Ra's energy-center roles: red is the foundation ray and yellow the stepping stone where mind/body balance fully. The red-orange-yellow triad springs the entity into the center ray, green, the resource for spiritual work. Blue is communication, indigo the gateway to intelligent infinity, and violet is constant (identity).

The common reading is fifth blue, sixth indigo, seventh violet, matching the order of the energy centers. Ra's and so forth in 40.3 supports the order, but Ra names none of these three in so many words and describes fifth and sixth only by appearance in 33.20 (white; white with gold). Treat this as an overlay.

owner_idea.label: departs
owner_idea.basis: Ra puts the choice in third density: third density is a choice (76.15), it exists for that choice and the choice is the axis of creation (76.16), and polarizing is required for harvest from third density, with the higher densities working on the polarity gained there (77.16). The veils that make the choice possible are third-density (77.14), little polarity is gained where thoughts are open (50.7), there is little work in consciousness in fourth and fifth density (48.6), and at fourth the veil is lifted and the choice already made (87.25). Free will is not new at fourth: it is the first distortion (15.21), and the wisdom density is called extremely free (43.14). What survives of the idea: the planet's move into fourth density is when the third-density choice is tested at harvest (13.22, 13.23, 17.1), and fourth density is where the result is lived. What fourth adds, by Ra: love or understanding, compassion, transparent selves, the social memory complex and green true color. Everything becomes 4 is not addressed by Ra: Ra describes sevens plus an octave (16.51). Method: every cited passage was read in the raw lawofone.info text of all 106 sessions. Claims are paraphrases of the cited session.question, with one verbatim quote given deliberately to respect copyright limits. Open the refs to confirm.

checks.note: Fetched lawofone.info/s/87. Ra's answer to 87.25 (question: 'Is it meaningful to give this ratio in early fourth density...?') contains exactly: 'It may be said that the veil in fourth density is lifted and the choice has been made.' The quoted fragment is a contiguous verbatim substring. The claim holds: the answer is about orgasm/sexual energy in higher densities, and the line comes mid-answer, between 'quite meaningless to speak of orgasm of male and female in higher densities' and 'In positive polarities true sharing is almost universal.' Minor strictness points: Ra hedges ('It may be said'), which the claim does not mention; Ra says the veil in fourth density 'is lifted' (a state), not that fourth density 'lifts' it; 'the choice' is the polarity choice, which the claim leaves implicit. 'The only verbatim quote in this output' is about the output, not Ra, and could not be checked.

16.21: 'first, the cycle of awareness'. 40.3: 'in first density the red ray is the foundation for all that is to come.' Both phrases match the row (color red, red ray the foundation, lesson awareness).
16.21: 'second, the cycle of growth'. 40.3: 'In second density the orange ray is that of movement and growth of the individual'. The parenthetical in the row is verbatim. Supports orange and growth.

13.21 ('third density which is the density of self-consciousness or self-awareness') and 16.21 ('third, the cycle of self-awareness') support the lesson. 41.14: 'The appropriate true color for third density is, as you have ascertained, yellow.' 76.15 ('The third density is a choice.'), 76.16 ('precisely correct' that third density exists 'for the purpose of this choice'), 77.16 ('polarization or choosing ... is necessary for harvestability from third density') and 30.1 (polarities explored once a third-density entity becomes aware of the choice between service to self and service to others) support the polarity-choice purpose. 'Service to others or to self' is the row's paraphrase and 'the purpose Ra confirms' is accurate for 76.16. All seven refs resolve and support.

Supported: 16.21 ('cycle of love or understanding'), 20.35 ('fourth density, the density of love or understanding'), 16.50 (aware of thoughts and vibrations of other-selves; compassion), 40.12 ('Selves are not hidden to self or other-selves'), 42.6 ('fourth density ... abounds in compassion'; 'social memory complex of fourth density'), 48.6 ('very little work in consciousness in fourth and in fifth densities compared to ... third'; positive social memory complex 'goes forth to aid those of less positive orientation'). Problems: (1) 40.11 says 'The vibratory nature of your environment is true color, green' (present tense, in session 40, 'heavily over-woven with the orange ray'); the row's gloss 'at contact' and 'the planet's' are not Ra's words, so color green is supported but the 'at contact' wording is not. (2) 11.17 defines a social memory complex generally and does not mention fourth density. (3) 87.25 supports 'the choice has been made' only loosely for 'the chosen polarity is lived here'. (4) 48.6 qualifies 'little new work': fourth-density negative has 'much work ... accomplished during the fighting for position' and there are 'minor amounts of catalyst' in fourth-density positive, so 'little new work in consciousness' is a simplification of Ra's comparison with third density.

33.20: 'Fifth density is perhaps best described as extremely white in vibration' (Ra also says 'We may speak only approximately'; the row's 'appearance' label does not carry that hedge). 16.21 and 25.11: 'density of light or wisdom'. 42.6: compassion is 'folly when seen through the eyes of wisdom' and Ra spent 'much time/space in contemplation' balancing it. 16.41: 'fifth-density harvest is of those whose vibratory distortions consciously accept the honor/duty of the Law of One.' 43.14: in fifth density entities 'may choose to learn as a social memory complex or as mind/body/spirit complexes'. 'Still polarized': 25.11 (fifth-density negative entity) and 78.24 (positive and negative social memory complexes) support it. A scan of the Ra answers I fetched (sessions 1-106) found no sentence pairing blue with fifth density, so 'not named by Ra beyond the pattern in 40.3' holds.

16.21: 'sixth, the cycle of light/love, love/light, or unity'. 59.3: 'The work of sixth density is to unify wisdom and compassion.' 33.20: 'The sixth density of a whiteness which contains a golden quality as you would perceive it ... This golden color is not of your spectrum but is what you would call alive.' 78.25: 'In sixth density, the density of unity, the positive and negative paths must needs take in each other ... at some point the negative polarity is abandoned.' 47.5: the polarity 'will, at the sixth level, simply become history'. 37.6: the higher self is 'given to the late sixth-density mind/body/spirit complex' (from mid-seventh). 14.19: 'I am sixth density'. The scan found no sentence naming indigo for sixth density, so 'not named by Ra' holds.

16.21: 'seventh, the gateway cycle'. 41.16: 'The seventh density is a density of completion and the turning towards timelessness or foreverness.' 39.4: 'the seventh-density being, the completed being ... compacts into the One Creator once again.' 16.22: at the seventh level Ra would 'become one with all'. 39.10: violet ray 'is constant ... the mark, the register, the identity, the true vibration of an entity.' Weak links: 3.10 names the Law of Foreverness but not the seventh density, so it is only indirect support. In 33.19 and 34.16 Ra also uses violet-ray aura and intensity as a harvest measure, so 'violet is described only as the constant energy center, identity' is slightly too strong, though Ra never assigns a color to seventh density.

16.21: 'eighth, the octave which moves into a mystery we do not plumb' (row paraphrases as 'a mystery Ra does not plumb'). 28.15: the eighth density 'functions also as the beginning density or first density, in its latter stages, of the next octave' (the row drops 'in its latter stages'). 52.12: 'This octave density ... is both omega and alpha ... Then is born a new universe, a new infinity, a new Logos.' 14.32: 'the intelligent infinity is brought into intelligent energy from eighth density or the octave.' 16.51 supports only the musical-octave analogy (the eighth note begins a new octave). No color is attributed, which fits 'not stated by Ra'.

result.labels:
**Claim-strength check: Law of One guide on what each density adds (2026-11-01)**

Source: I checked every cited session.question against the local copy of the lawofone.info text (a local text copy; path removed). Claims are numbered 1–59 in guide order (q1 = 1–11, q2 = 12–21, q3 = 22–28, q4 = 29–35, q5 = 36–40, q6 = 41–44, q7 = 45–52, q8 = 53–59). Ra is paraphrased below, with one short quote, to respect copyright.

**A. Correct as labelled (41 claims)**
1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 10, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 18, 19, 21, 22, 23, 24, 26, 27, 28, 30, 31, 33, 34, 36, 37, 38, 41, 42, 45, 47, 48, 49, 50, 51, 53, 54, 56, 57, 58.
- 10 (COMMON "density of choice"): a search of the text finds no such phrase in Ra.
- 37 (3.10): the guide already marks the density mapping as inference.

**B. Claims stronger than the text supports (corrected labels)**
- **6 (87.25):** Ra hedges this line (it "may be said"), and "lifted" describes a state rather than an act. Label: RA (hedged). The verbatim check holds.
- **8 (50.7):** Ra names two settings, time/space between incarnations and the true-color green density. The guide merges them into "green density in time/space". Ra also says there is no deception and no wish for it, not that deception is impossible. Label: RA, with the wording fixed.
- **9 (69.11):** "The choice is not frozen at the end of third density" generalises from one case. The case is a positive Wanderer in a thoroughly negative environment, whose reversal may wait until mid-sixth density. Label: RA for the case, GUIDE for the generalisation. Stronger direct support for the general point:
  - 47.5: about 2% move from negative to positive during fourth density.
  - 36.15: the sixth-density negative entity consciously chooses an instantaneous reorientation.
- **11 (GUIDE, third vs fourth):** The conclusion holds. It leaves out that choosing continues after third density (76.16 "continuous refining", 47.5, 36.15). Label: GUIDE, incomplete.
- **17 (40.6; 40.11):** Neither passage says fourth density's true color is green. 40.11 says the environment is green "at this time" (session 40, 1981). The direct link is 63.8 (the green-ray cycle is the density of love and understanding), with 41.14 in support. I would overrule the verifier's "at contact" objection, since session 40 was during the contact. Add 63.8 and 41.14.
- **20 (17.29):** The year 2011 comes from the questioner. Ra calls it an approximation and a probable/possible nexus. Minor rewording.
- **25 and 32 (33.20):** "Appearance, not a named true color" is the guide's gloss inside an RA tag. Ra calls these colors and says each density has a distinct color structure, while hedging that it can speak only approximately. Label: RA for white and for white with gold; GUIDE for the appearance-versus-true-color split.
- **29 (78.25):** "Not as an even blend" is the guide's gloss. Ra says both paths must take in each other, and then the negative is abandoned. Label: RA plus a GUIDE gloss; add 36.15.
- **35 (36.10):** "Not identical" is too strong. 36.10 says the higher self is a projection or manifestation of the totality, and 37.6 says all three are the same being, distinct only in time. Corrected to that wording.
- **39 (39.4):** Ra says spiritual mass grows significantly but not greatly until the gateway density, not "slowly". Minor wording fix.
- **40 (GUIDE, seventh color):** The conclusion holds: no true color for seventh density appears anywhere in the text. "Violet is described only as identity" is too strong. Violet is also the harvest gauge (33.19, 34.16, 48.7) and the passport to the next octave (48.10). 47.8 is hedged ("may perhaps").
- **43 (40.1):** Ra says the octave transition enters timelessness and that part of it is timeless. "The transition is timeless" is slightly too strong.
- **44 (11.8):** Misapplied. The "eighth level" in 11.8 is the intelligent-infinity level that a third-density entity reaches for harvest. It is not the eighth density or the octave. Drop 11.8 from q6, or mark it GUIDE. 14.32 holds.
- **46 (40.3):** "Not an inclusion of the previous ones" is the guide's gloss. It is partly contradicted by 40.3 itself (red is the foundation for all that is to come) and by 39.10 (red strengthens each density). Label: RA for the forward pull (also 40.6); GUIDE for the "not inclusion" part, now weakened.
- **52 (GUIDE, no "contains" rule):** Holds as GUIDE, but the list of nearest passages is incomplete. Add:
  - 40.3: red is the foundation for all that is to come.
  - 39.10: red strengthens each density.
  - 63.8: the fourth-density sphere coexists with first, second and third.
  - 48.7: each of the seven true-color densities has analog centers, and the infant contains the universe.
  Label: GUIDE, partly supported.
- **55 (GUIDE, distortions vs densities):** The 1–2–3 mapping really is an overlay. "Any mapping is an overlay" is too strong: in 27.13 Ra says the density sequence love → light (4th → 5th) recapitulates creation in reverse, while warning that the senses differ. 3.10 gives laws of love → light → One → Foreverness. Corrected label: 1–3 mapping = overlay; a 4th/5th parallel = RA (27.13).
- **59 (COMMON, 5th blue / 6th indigo / 7th violet):** Too weak for blue and indigo. In 48.7 Ra says Wanderers have "the green, blue, or indigo true-color core". Wanderers come from fourth, fifth and sixth density (12.28, 32.9). In 40.3 the questioner proposes colors "and so on through the densities", and Ra says this is more correct than he stated. Corrected labels:
  - Blue and indigo: a strong inference from several Ra passages. No single sentence states it, and 33.20 (white; white with gold) is unresolved tension.
  - Violet for seventh: stays COMMON.
  - The verifier's "no sentence pairs blue with fifth" is literally true, but its scan missed 48.7.

**C. Verifier corrections**
- I agree with the verifier on 87.25 and on the table rows for 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 5th, 6th, 7th and 8th.
- 4th row: its points (2), (3) and (4) stand. Point (1) is overruled, as under claim 17.
- 5th and 6th rows: "not named" needs the 48.7 qualifier.

**D. Owner-idea label**
"Departs" is right for "the choice is what fourth density adds". The basis overstates in places:
- 43.14 ("extremely free") is about learning individually or as a group. It is not evidence about free will; drop it.
- 87.25 needs Ra's hedge.
- 48.6 needs its qualifier: little work in consciousness compared with third.
- The "what survives" part leaves out 47.5, 36.15 and 76.16.
- "Everything becomes 4" is ambiguous. The guide read it as numerology, and Ra's structure is sevens plus an octave (16.51, 47.8). Read as "the planet or everyone becomes fourth density", Ra partly contradicts it:
  - 13.23: many will repeat third density.
  - 63.8: the fourth-density sphere coexists with first to third, and third density may later cycle again on the yellow sphere.
- "Every cited passage was read" is a process claim I cannot verify. The misreadings of 50.7 and 11.8 and the missed 48.7 show the reading was not error-free.

Corrected label: departs (what fourth adds). Partly, on the timing reading only (the third-density choice comes due at the harvest during the 3→4 transition).

**Corrected 4-line verdict on "choice is what fourth density adds"**
1. Departs: Ra puts the polarity choice in third density. Third density is a choice and exists for it (76.15–16), polarizing is needed for harvest and powers the higher densities (77.16), and the veils that make choosing possible are absent above third (77.14).
2. What fourth adds, per Ra: love/understanding and compassion, open selves (telepathy), social memory complexes and green true color (16.21, 20.35, 42.6, 40.12, 38.14, 45.11, 63.8). Ra says, hedged, that by then the veil is lifted and the choice made (87.25).
3. Choosing does not stop at third, but fourth does not add it. The later densities refine the choice (76.16), about 2% switch from negative to positive during fourth (47.5), and sixth-density negatives consciously reorient (36.15, 78.25).
4. What survives is the timing: Earth is already in fourth-density space/time (13.22), and the harvest Ra places approximately at 2011 (17.29) is when the third-density choice counts. "Everything becomes 4" is not Ra: many will repeat third density (13.23), the fourth-density sphere coexists with first to third (63.8), and Ra's structure is sevens plus an octave (16.51).
